title: 5 Questions To Mental Freedom
text: [Music] many of the things that i teach sometimes you may not even know why i teach them but this is what drives me this is what motivates me this is the five questions that make me wake up in the morning and talk to you and pray for you and teach and write books and sing and write songs and why i have conferences and what i'm after is these five questions and according to jesus in luke 4 the anointing of god was upon him to set the captives free and to set the oppressed free it's possible for you to be delivered and still oppressed what are the five questions number one who am i most people haven't answered that question yet and that's why they're still dressing like other people and acting like other people and fixing their hair like other people and following styles and following moods and following fashions and following what's in and going with hip and why they don't know who they are they're trying to find themselves and nothing is more detrimental than trying to be somebody you're not and saints in the church still don't know who they are they know where they're going they go into heaven but they don't know who they are the second question we must answer is where am i from where am i from if you don't know where you came from you're going to be in bondage now a lot of folks think that they came from africa or they came from england or they came from poland or they came from china or they came from this and they keep going back to our physical heritage so to speak look in this room you guys are so mixed up you don't know where to go some of you got white and black and indian all mixed up where you gonna go if you try to go back to find yourself you don't know where to go so we gotta deal with something more important than just ethnic heritage if you don't know where you came from and you only use your ethnicity ethnicity is that it if you just use that to try and find your heritage then you are going to be in trouble because you're going to find out that you're going to be split about five or six different ways third question you must answer is why am i here an oppressed person lack a sense of purpose they don't know why they exist the third question why am i here and the fourth question is what can i do we must answer that question to live effectively that means what is my ability what is my true potential what am i really capable of doing and if you are not able to answer the question of your ability and your potential then people will dominate your powers they will overrun and overrule and literally tell you what you cannot do and the fourth question is where am i going some people have no future they have no direction they have no sense of destiny you've got to know where you're going when you're oppressed these five questions are stripped from you when you're oppressed your oppressor gives the answer to these five questions when you are oppressed the oppressor determines who you are where you came from what you can do why you're here and where you're going the oppressor dictates to you who you are someone said to me in south africa that they read that people of color were born just to carry water and cut wood so that's what they taught the people in their church in the church now you've been taught that for 300 years it can be difficult for you to change your attitude toward me so when i come into the room even though i got on a suit you say there's a well-dressed woodcutter see your mind hasn't changed he said well there's a dignified water carrier why because mentally your mind hasn't changed and there are people in our own country who are still under the oppression of the colonial mentality and there are people here who are still oppressors and even though they may promote you they don't accept you and even though they may let you wear a tie and be a supervisor you are a water carrying supervisor to them you still a woodcutter because the mentality needs to be renewed god will bring transformation when you change now the trouble is this if the oppressed is set free then the oppressor loses his power over them i'm going to say this again if the oppressed is set free then the oppressor loses his power over them it's difficult for you to tell me something or to do something when i know that that's not for me to do we need therefore to understand that freedom is the key to living effectively not deliverance
